name: Shanai no Kedamono!?
source:
Today, you broke up with your boyfriend…you are very depressed because he was the one you've been dating for many years. However, your colleague suddenly confessed his love to you! Not only him, but also three other types of hot guys are all starting to approach you!

They try to win your love in their own ways! The way they approach you is somehow too hot and wild, so you wouldn't tell anyone! Finally, your heart is stolen by 'the one'…

[Edited from [url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/134909313616/mybossistoohotandwild]English Otome Games[/url]]
translation:
今天，你和男朋友分手了……因为交往多年，你非常消沉。然而，同事突然向你告白！不只是他，另外三种类型的帅哥也开始接近你！

他们用各自的方式争取你的爱！他们接近你的方式实在太炽热、太狂野，你绝不会告诉任何人！最终，你的心被“那个人”夺走……

[改编自[url=http://www.englishotomegames.net/post/134909313616/mybossistoohotandwild]English Otome Games[/url]]
